question: Does exact-value identity add information beyond a validation-tuned target-aware PLE, and is any surviving gain specifically attributable to high-mass atoms?
development_status: Adult test labels were already inspected on Day 1, so this is a mechanism falsification rather than a confirmatory benchmark.
selection_metric: mean validation log loss across tuning seeds; ties broken by fewer total T-PLE bins, then grid order
primary_mechanism_contrast: T-PLE plus full identity versus T-PLE
atom_specific_contrast: Q-PLE plus atom-only indicators versus Q-PLE
transfer_gate: Proceed only if the primary contrast improves validation log loss and validation AUC, and the four-seed test ensemble improves AUC. Treat the method as atom-specific only if the atom-only contrast also improves.
